title: UTM Link Builder
h1: UTM Link Builder — Campaign URL Parameters
seoTitle: UTM Link Builder — Campaign Tracking URLs
description: Build a campaign URL with utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign and optional term and content. Values are encoded for safe sharing. Runs locally.
intro: Paste a landing-page URL and fill the campaign fields. The builder appends standard UTM parameters with correct encoding so analytics can attribute the click.
blurb: Append encoded UTM parameters to a landing-page URL for campaign tracking.
howItWorks: Enter the full page URL, including https://.
Fill source, medium and campaign. Term and content are optional and skipped when blank.
Press Build URL. Spaces and reserved characters are percent-encoded and joined with &.
examples: https://example.com/pricing with source newsletter, medium email and campaign spring-launch.
A blank term field is omitted instead of adding an empty utm_term.
Spaces in a campaign name are encoded so the link stays valid.

faq.q: What do the UTM fields mean?
faq.a: Source is where the click came from, medium is the channel type, and campaign names the promotion. Term and content distinguish keywords or creatives.

faq.q: Will this overwrite existing query parameters?
faq.a: No. Existing query parameters stay, and the UTM pairs are appended. A hash fragment is kept at the end of the URL.

faq.q: Does this call an analytics service?
faq.a: No. It only assembles the link in your browser. Tracking happens later if the destination site reads the parameters.
